name: image-sequence
title: Image sequence
description: Scrub through a set of frames by dragging or hovering: a 360-degree product spin, a flipbook or a video hover preview, with keyboard stepping and a slider role.
docs: frames is a list of image addresses (keep the array stable between renders). mode='drag' turns the picture as the pointer is dragged (sensitivity 1 means dragging across it shows every frame once; loop wraps past the ends); mode='hover' maps the pointer's place along the picture to a frame and rests on the first when it leaves. The first frame shows at once and the rest are preloaded behind it in batches of four, with a thin line along the top; until a frame arrives the nearest loaded one stays up. The picture is a slider named by alt: arrows step one frame, Page Up and Page Down ten percent, Home and End jump, and aria-valuetext reads 'Frame 12 of 36'. autoRotate (drag only) turns it once, slowly, on first view, never under reduced motion. Vertical swipes still scroll the page.
